messages:
jordan: Heads up — getting multiple customer reports of 502/504 + timeouts on hosted API since ~13:02 UTC. High p95 tail timeouts and an uptick in queue_rejects. @oncall can you triage?

maya: seeing same in grafana — continuous-batcher backlog spiking on the gateway pool. queue_depth hitting 512/512 on several hosts. :eyes:

simon: any correlating auth or billing errors? last time we saw pileups it was a token rotation bug that caused extra retries.

support-bot: Customer tickets: #C-1189 (AcmeApp) and #C-1192 (MaplePay) both show client 5xx and long server side latency.

alice: i pulled traces for a repro request — requests are queued for ~1.6s then timeout in the batcher with 504. logs show "enqueue_delay=1620ms" and repeated "batch/full queue" messages. snippet: ```[2026-03-17T13:05:21Z] WARN batcher: enqueue_delay=1620ms queue_len=512 batch_size=1 route=hosted-gateway```

devin: looks like KV-cache warmups are also happening (kvcache_misses spiking). when cache spins up the batcher latency jumps and queue depth fills. could be a cold-path cascade.

jordan: customers also reported auth failures earlier (401s) for some requests which triggered client-side retries. logs: "auth: token refresh 502 from auth.redwood.internal" — not sure if related.

maya: current mitigation idea: temporarily lower continuous-batcher max_batch_window to 50ms for the affected pool, and increase queue_depth soft limit to 800 to avoid immediate rejects while we stabilize. patch would be low-risk? :thinking_face:

simon: lowering batch window reduces batching efficiency but should cut tail latency. we need to also check routing fallback to smaller model variants to reduce per-token cost/perf.

alice: repro steps I used: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer REPRO_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-open-7b","input":"<long prompt>"}' -v``` repeat ~1000 concurrent connections. captured stack: ```queue.enqueue: failed to allocate slot: full (512) -> enqueue_delay=1500ms -> request timeout 60s -> 504```

devin: digging into auth logs now. there are intermittent 502 responses from auth service around 13:00-13:06 that coincide with customer retries. may be a red herring but worth confirming.

oncall: I'm on it. running quick rollback to batcher window=50ms on pool hosted-prod-3 and bumping queue soft limit by +300 for next 10 minutes. will monitor p95.

jordan: please also check billing/client token expirations — one ticket says their test tokens expired mid-run and client SDK retried aggressively.

maya: added a short-lived circuit to drop repeated auth retries at ingress for the tenant to avoid noisy neighbors. also enabled additional logging for kvcache misses. :white_check_mark:

simon: recorded a runbook note: if queue_depth==512 and enqueue_delay>1000ms for >2m, trigger autoscale and reduce batch window. file: `runbooks/queue_spillback.md` (internal).

alice: next steps: collect traces for a few affected request ids and correlate with auth logs + kvcache warmups. plan a postmortem if this recurs in 24h.

devin: update — auth team confirms a transient deploy caused increased latency on token refresh endpoint at 12:58. they rolled back at 13:04. likely contributed to retry storm.

jordan: thanks everyone. keeping thread open until p95 < 300ms and queue_depth stable under 300 for 10m. will update customers with status. :thumbsup:
